payload.name: Persist containing region for location events
payload.description: When constructing memories from a message that names a city or place, also extract its confidently known state/province/country so region-level questions can be answered.
content: During extraction, when a message mentions a specific city, town, or landmark, include its confidently known containing state/province/country in the same memory candidate rather than storing only the local place name.

During CREATE/UPDATE/MERGE enrichment, if adding a location detail to an existing memory, also add the containing region of that detail when confidently known, so the memory can support state-level and country-level queries.
Only add the containing region when it follows from established geographic knowledge; do not guess or infer regions from context that is not entailed.

solves: A location-bearing event was stored only with the city name, leaving later state/country-level claims unsupported. The mechanism is that place names entail a containing administrative region that should be persisted alongside the event. This applies to extraction and enrichment whenever a confidently known state/province/country exists for a mentioned place; it does not apply to invented or unverifiable locations.
